units.source_text: 过了不久，我去看望先生，先生不在家，便有了和夫人聊天的机会。

en.t: Before long, I went to visit Sensei, but he was not at home, so I had a chance to talk with his wife.

units.source_text: 那天，先生到新桥去，为一个从横滨乘船出国的朋友送行。

en.t: That day, Sensei had gone to Shimbashi to see off a friend who was leaving the country by ship from Yokohama.

units.source_text: 那时候，一般去横滨乘船的人，大多是坐早上八点半发自新桥的火车。

en.t: In those days, people who went to Yokohama to board a ship usually took the train that left Shimbashi at eight thirty in the morning.

units.source_text: 我需要向先生请教一本书，事先跟先生约定九点钟到先生家，

en.t: I needed to ask Sensei about a book, and I had arranged with him beforehand to go to his house at nine o'clock.

units.source_text: 先生突然决定去新桥送行，是为了还礼，因朋友头天特意来辞行。

en.t: Sensei's sudden decision to go to Shimbashi to see him off was a courtesy in return, because the friend had made a special visit the day before to say farewell.

units.source_text: 先生临走时留下话，说他很快就回来，要我等他。

en.t: As Sensei left, he left word that he would be back soon and that I should wait for him.

units.source_text: 于是，我就进了客厅，等先生的时候，同夫人聊了起来。

en.t: So I went into the sitting room and began talking with his wife while I waited for Sensei.
